_about: Named sets of NACE Rev. 2 sections that regulations define. Each is cited to the official text with its verbatim definition. Read through services.reference.nace.sector_set().

high_impact_climate_sectors.source: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/1288, Annex I, definition (9), OJ L 196, 25.7.2022, p. 38
high_impact_climate_sectors.quote: ‘high impact climate sectors’ means the sectors listed in Sections A to H and Section L of Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 1893/2006
